entry.title: Agentic Software: How AI Agents Are Restructuring the Software Paradigm
entry.summary: We argue that the emergence of AI agents <systems where LLMs serve as the primary reasoning engine> constitutes a restructuring of what software is. Code becomes an instrumental resource rather than the carrier of decision logic. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/example/agentic.

entry.title: Harness Engineering for Agentic AI Coding Tools: An Exploratory Study
entry.summary: An exploratory study of harness design for coding agents & their failure modes across 12 teams.
